div.p: For new students: the full TRE™ Provider Certification 2027 in Singapore — all three modules, all online personal sessions and supervisions, ICF credits and three self-paced bonus programmes. Early bird S$5,888 until 31 March 2027.

img.alt: TRE™ Provider Certification 2027 Singapore with Isabelle Claus Teixeira and Simba Stenqvist: Growth Package, Module 1 24–25 Apr, Module 2 3–4 Jul, Module 3 30–31 Oct 2027

figure.figcaption: Tap to open the full-size poster to save or share it.

div.p: TRE™ is a body-led series of simple, powerful exercises to release stress, tension and trauma and build resilience. It safely activates the body's natural reflex of shaking or vibrating, which helps calm the nervous system and release muscular tension — allowing the body to naturally return to a balanced state.

The Global TRE™ Provider Certification program allows certificate holders to offer TRE™ to the general public in both individual and group settings. The 2027 cohort is co-taught by Isabelle Claus Teixeira and Simba Stenqvist.
Only one cohort per year in Singapore — dates for 2027 are confirmed below.

The Growth Package is for new students who want the full Global TRE™ Provider Certification — Modules 1–3, all online personal sessions and supervisions, ICF credits and three self-paced bonus programmes.

ul.li: Modules 1–3 in Singapore (24–25 Apr, 3–4 Jul, 30–31 Oct 2027)
All online personal sessions and supervisions
ICF CCEs: 21 for Module 1 with the Growth Package (CCEs pending confirmation for Module 2), released on full attendance of the relevant module
Three self-paced bonus programmes (value S$1,290): Grounding, Verbal Interventions, Internal Alchemy

div.p: Three self-paced online programmes, together valued at S$1,290, come with this package. Grounding unlocks once Instalment 2 is received (due by 3 June 2027). Verbal Interventions and Internal Alchemy unlock once Instalment 3 is received (due by 30 September 2027). If you pay the full package price at registration, all three unlock after Module 2 (3–4 July 2027).
Per module, as included in the Growth Package.
2-day workshop + personal sessions: 2 online individual and 2 online group sessions (group sessions on 5 May & 1 Jun 2027).
2-day workshop + 2 online group supervisions + 2 online individual supervisions.

2-day workshop + 3 online individual supervisions + 1 online group supervision. The final module: complete it, its supervisions and the remaining certification requirements to become a Global TRE™ Provider.
The Foundational Package is the same programme without ICF credits and without the bonus programmes.

tr.td: ICF CCEs — 21 for Module 1 confirmed; Module 2 pending

The full package price is owed once the first instalment is paid.
Prefer to pay in full? You can pay the full package price at registration instead of three instalments. Card charges still apply.
Instalment 1 is due on registration — by 31 Mar 2027 at the early-bird price, by 22 Apr 2027 at the regular price.
Instalment 2 is issued after Module 1 and due by 3 June 2027. Instalment 3 is issued after Module 2 and due by 30 September 2027.
Extra online personal sessions or supervisions (any package): S$190 per 60-minute online session.
ICF credits are included in the Growth Package.
All ticket sales are final — tickets are non-refundable and non-cancellable.

div.h2: Taught by Two Global TRE™ Certifying Trainers

div.span: Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer · ICF PCC
div.p: Accredited by TRE™ for All under Dr. David Berceli's methodology — the highest level of qualification to certify new TRE™ Providers worldwide. Over 30 years of human development experience and somatic practice, training practitioners across Europe, Asia, the US and beyond.

div.span: Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer · Creator of Internal Alchemy
div.p: Somatic practitioner with more than 25 years of hands-on practice in bodywork, nervous system regulation and energetic healing — developed in close collaboration with Dr. David Berceli, founder of TRE™. Simba leads the Grounding and Introduction to Internal Alchemy bonus programs included in this certification.
One cohort per year. Choose your package and share your details — Isabelle will confirm your place and send your first instalment link.
